date_note: The Elec (27 November) quotes Pamtek as saying the server was found encrypted on 23 November.
exec: Pamtek told The Elec a server was found ransomware-encrypted and that shareholder and former-employee data may have leaked; it has not confirmed a leak.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; no city given
plain: Korean camera-module maker Pamtek says a server was hit by ransomware on 23 November and restored from backups. Shareholder and ex-employee data may have leaked, but the company has not confirmed that.
summary: According to Pamtek, as reported by The Elec, an external attacker infected a specific server with ransomware, found encrypted on 23 November. The company restored it from backups and reported to KISA and the Personal Information Protection Commission the next day. It warned that personal data of shareholders and past employees may have leaked, but a company official said a leak is not confirmed.
title: Pamtek says a server was found ransomware-encrypted on 23 November; data leak possible but not confirmed

validation.note: Only The Elec was read; it relays Pamtek's own statements. The company's own notice was not read.

review.note: Compared date 23 Nov, backup restore, KISA/PIPC report, possible leak unconfirmed against The Elec
